map.根据复发性阿弗他溃疡(RAS)的大小、数量、病程与愈合特征，进行分型与病期判断。: Classifies and stages recurrent aphthous ulcers (RAS) by size, count, course and healing characteristics.
map.轻型溃疡直径 <5mm、7~10 天自愈，工具判定为轻型 RAS 并提示自限。: A mild ulcer under 5 mm heals in 7-10 days; the tool judges it a mild RAS and notes it is self-limiting.
map.大型深在溃疡 >10mm、病程数周，提示重型（腺周口疮）需就诊。: A large deep ulcer over 10 mm lasting weeks indicates a major form (perennial aphthous ulcer) that needs medical attention.
map.复发频繁者量化年发作次数，提示系统排查诱因。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: For frequent recurrences, quantify the number of episodes per year and prompt a systematic check for triggers. (The results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examinations, radiographic assessment such as periapical films or CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists or periodontists; if you have tooth pain, gum bleeding, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, seek care promptly at a proper hospital dental department.)

map.RAS 分哪几型？: How many types of RAS are there?
map.轻型（最常见，<5mm 自愈）、重型（腺周口疮，深大、瘢痕）、疱疹样（多发小溃疡: Mild (most common, self-healing under 5 mm), major (perennial aphthous, deep and large, scarring) and herpetiform (clusters of multiple small ulcers), distinguished by size and course.
map.与遗传、免疫、压力、创伤、营养（铁/B 族）及消化因素有关；频繁或重型建议排查全: It relates to genetic, immune, stress, trauma, nutritional (iron and B vitamins) and digestive factors; frequent or severe cases should trigger a check for systemic causes.
map.什么情况要就医？: When should I see a doctor?
map.溃疡 >2 周不愈、直径 >10mm、伴发热或皮疹、或有白红斑病变，应尽早到口腔: An ulcer not healing after 2 weeks, over 10 mm in diameter, accompanied by fever or rash, or with white-red plaque lesions, should be seen at an oral mucosal clinic as soon as possible to rule out malignancy.
